recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, cartoon-style illustration depicting a sad, anthropomorphic red heart standing on a tropical island. The background features a sunset sky with dolphins, an ocean, and palm trees, all rendered with a distinct halftone texture.
coreVisualRelationships: The sad heart character is the central and largest element, positioned in the lower-middle of the frame.
The tropical island environment with palm trees, ocean, and sunset forms the backdrop for the heart.
The dolphins in the sky and birds near the sun add dynamic elements to the upper portion of the scene.
The halftone texture is consistently applied across all elements, unifying the visual style.
coreInvariants: The central character is a red, anthropomorphic heart with a sad expression, arms, and legs.
The setting is a tropical island with palm trees, an ocean, and a sunset.
Dolphins are present in the sky, and small birds are near the sun.
A halftone dot pattern is applied to all colors, creating a retro or printed aesthetic.
The color palette is bright and saturated, dominated by reds, oranges, yellows, blues, and greens.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sad heart character is centrally located, occupying a significant portion of the lower half of the image, making it the dominant subject. Its scale is large relative to the island features.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red heart character serves as the primary visual anchor due to its central placement, large size, and contrasting color against the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the sad heart, then moves upwards to the sunset and dolphins, and finally scans the surrounding island elements. The implied movement of the dolphins and the sun's rays add dynamism.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space is present; the composition is filled with vibrant elements. The sky and ocean provide some open areas but are still textured and colored.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Red (heart) and orange/yellow (sunset/sand) are dominant, establishing a warm and somewhat melancholic tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Blue (ocean) and light purple (dolphins) provide cool contrast to the warm dominant colors, balancing the palette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green (palm trees) and pink (flowers, sky highlights) act as accents, adding vibrancy and detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: All colors are highly saturated and generally mid-to-high in value, contributing to a bright, energetic, yet slightly distressed feel due to the halftone.
paletteRestrictions: Incorporate halftone dot patterns for all color fills.
Maintain clear color separation between elements.

graphicDevices: Thick, dark outlines for all cartoon elements.
Simplified, iconic shapes for natural elements (palm trees, dolphins, sun).

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant, cartoon-style illustration of a tropical island scene. Include a sunset with radiating lines, an ocean, and two palm trees on sandy hills. In the sky, add two stylized dolphins and three small birds. Apply a consistent halftone dot pattern to all color fills. Ensure the color palette is bright and saturated, featuring reds, oranges, yellows, blues, greens, and purples. Leave a central space in the lower half of the image for the main character.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a large, anthropomorphic red heart character in the central lower half of the image. The heart should have a sad expression (single eye, downturned mouth), thin black arms with white-gloved hands, and black legs with black shoes. Outline the heart and its features with a thick black line. Ensure the halftone pattern is also applied to the heart's red fill.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern consistently applied across all colored areas?
Are the colors vibrant and saturated?
Is the heart character clearly sad and anthropomorphic?
Are the tropical island elements (palm trees, ocean, sunset) present?
Are the dolphins and birds included in the sky?
Are all elements outlined with a thick, dark line?

adjustableVariables: Specific hues within the vibrant palette
Density and size of the halftone dots
Exact positioning of background elements (dolphins, palm trees)
Expression details of the heart character (e.g., tear drops)

mustAchieve: Consistent application of a halftone texture.
The central character must be a sad, anthropomorphic red heart.
The setting must be identifiable as a tropical island with a sunset.
avoid: Happy or neutral expression on the heart character.

postGenerationChecks: Does the generated image accurately reflect the sad, anthropomorphic heart as the main subject?
Is the tropical island setting with sunset, ocean, and palm trees clearly depicted?
Is the halftone texture consistently applied to all colored areas, giving it a retro print feel?
Are the colors vibrant and saturated as described?
Are the dolphins and birds present in the sky?
Is the overall mood melancholic yet visually engaging?
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a vibrant, cartoon-style tropical island scene with a prominent, sad, anthropomorphic red heart as the central figure. Apply a consistent halftone dot pattern to all colors. Include a sunset, ocean, palm trees, dolphins, and birds. Maintain a high-saturation color palette with thick black outlines for all elements.
